prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 as the visual style reference, create a new single-panel square illustration in the same playful hand-drawn editorial style: thick black outlines, flat bright colors, slightly rough marker texture, simple shapes, and lots of white margin. Replace the collage with one central scene: a sad office worker walking left across a zebra crossing in the rain, holding a black briefcase, wearing a black suit and tie. Add exactly 1 large white rain cloud above him, vertical rain strokes falling only around him, a soft irregular pink background block, an orange road/crosswalk area with white crossing stripes, and exactly 2 small green bushes in the background, one on each side. Keep the composition minimal and poster-like. Add a black rounded rectangle label at the top left with white bold text reading AI Image result. Optional customization: the main subject may be changed to sad office worker, the weather mood to rain cloud, and the background color block to soft pink. Do not reuse the four-panel layout or the original characters/animals; only reuse the visual brand style.

promptZh: 仅使用 REFERENCE_0 作为视觉风格参考，创作一幅全新的方形编辑类插画，保持同样俏皮的手绘马克笔质感，包括粗黑轮廓线、简单的平涂色彩、略显粗糙的边缘以及极简的涂鸦式细节。请勿重复使用参考图中的角色或场景；改为描绘 一位身穿黑色西装的忧郁商务人士 拿着 一个黑色公文包 走在斑马线上。在他上方添加一朵白色雨云，垂直的雨线落在他身上，背景为柔和且不规则的 粉色，两侧配有绿色灌木丛，路面为橙红色并带有白色斑马线条。在左上角包含一个黑色的圆角矩形标签，其中带有白色粗体文字 AI Image result。保持构图简洁、居中，并与参考拼贴风格保持品牌一致性；无需额外文字，无水印，拒绝照片写实风格。
